agentName: P4 NCS Source & Duty-Level Mapping Engineer
purpose: Defines the minimum contract Agent 2's posting/track/section pipeline output must satisfy before Agent 4 will run real (non-fixture) NCS mapping.

requiredTopLevelFields.crawlReleaseId: e.g. CRAWL_20260806_02 -- the Agent 1 release this pipeline run was built from
requiredTopLevelFields.postingTrackPath: path to the track-level output file
requiredTopLevelFields.postingSectionPath: path to the section-level output file
requiredTopLevelFields.requirementFactPath: path to the requirement-fact-level output file
requiredTopLevelFields.inputSha256: sha256 of each of the three files above, keyed by filename
requiredTopLevelFields.rowCounts: row counts for each of the three files, keyed by filename
requiredTopLevelFields.eligibleDutyCount: count of rows where ncsEligibleFlag=true across the input

requiredRowFields.trackId: canonical SHA-256 id per AGENT3_TO_AGENT2_HANDOFF.json keyMigration (TRK_ + sha256(postingId|trackIndex)[:20])
requiredRowFields.canonicalPostingId: postingId of the dedup-selected representative posting this track belongs to
requiredRowFields.sectionType: enum, e.g. dutyDescription/qualification/preferred/other -- must distinguish duty text from qualification/preferred text
requiredRowFields.evidenceText: the raw duty/task text Agent 4 will run retrieval+mapping against
requiredRowFields.jobCode: Agent 2's own job-type classification code, if any (separate from ncsUnitCode)
requiredRowFields.ncsEligibleFlag: per AGENT3_TO_AGENT2_HANDOFF.json definition: RQ2-eligible track with defensible duty/task context
requiredRowFields.canonicalPostedAt: canonical posting date for temporal analysis
requiredRowFields.canonicalRecordFlag: dedup-selected representative flag, independent of source/text eligibility

explicitNonRequirements: Agent 4 does NOT need externalApplyUrl/externalAtsDomain -- those are RQ2 eligibility inputs already resolved upstream into ncsEligibleFlag
Agent 4 does NOT need full posting body text, only the duty/task-scoped evidenceText per section

untilThisArrives.behavior: Agent 4 mapping code runs only against local fixtures under ncs_mapping/tests/fixtures/, never against production duty data
untilThisArrives.fixtureFlag: any report referencing mapping precision/coverage before this handoff is satisfied must be marked NOT_EVALUATED, not a real score
